title: Fix Brep Geometric Operations
description: Rework brepjs@18 kernel adapter: unwrap Result types, fix API signatures, honor extrude direction, expose missing neuron parameters.
summary: Fixed cut/intersect and most solid ops by unwrapping brepjs Result values and matching brepjs@18 signatures. Extrude now uses sketchExtrude/extrude with direction vectors instead of Z-only profile shortcuts. Transforms convert radians to degrees and use correct rotate/mirror argument order. Added neuron ports for axis, plane, center, direction on rotate/revolve/mirror/scale/draft/slice/patterns. Extended kernel and procedural tests for cut, non-Z extrude, rotate, mirror.
